title: Reference approach: Shape Manipulator
answer: Implement shape manipulator in a small isolated script. Required implementation evidence includes: reshape, torch.cat, torch.split. Use a reproducible seed, report observed output, and explain relevant edge cases.
explanation: This exercise consolidates the topic from lesson 026. The list of required strings is only a minimal static signal; inspect numerical correctness, error handling, and test outcomes manually.
example_code:
import torch
x = torch.arange(12).reshape(3, 4); flat = x.flatten(); parts = torch.split(flat, 6)
joined = torch.cat(parts); print(x.shape, flat.shape, torch.equal(joined, flat))
